message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5 && sed -n '340,400p' src/H5Fsuper_cache.c` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
The vulnerability is triggered when a metadata cache entry has a size smaller than 4 bytes (H5_SIZEOF_CHKSUM). The most likely candidate is the superblock cache (`H5Fsuper_cache.c:389`) since the superblock is the first thing read when opening a file with `H5Fopen`.
